correctness.rationale: Cauchy Crofton hit-line mass equals L+2πr; uniform small-radius localization at vertices; at each rounded wedge the two circular endpoint branch and the two arc/tangent branches give J_ω(s)=ωH(s)+Ψ(s) for s<2sin(ω/2); sum of exterior angles gives exact law. Uniform boundary-layer Taylor integration yields Ψ=-s³/30+O(s⁵), H=s²/8+s⁴/128+O(s⁶). Independent polygon clipping and direct line-offset bisection agree numerically. Limits: fixed P, small r, short s only.
